column1: # Residue names the GWS writer emits and the reader could not read back.
# This file used to list 33 names by hand. It was five rows, because the property is checked
# rather than transcribed: GwsReadsTheNamesItWritesTest walks conf/residue_types and
# conf/non_symbolic_residue_types, writes each residue with the writer, reads it back and compares.
# A hand list was wrong twice - the count was given as 6, then 33, and is 35 - and a list cannot stay
# true when somebody adds a row. See ../README.md, rule 3.
# Widening the reader's name class (docs/gws-format.md 1.3) took it from 35 to the 5 below, and not
# one of the 5 is a grammar problem. Each is a row in conf/non_symbolic_residue_types that no reader
# can be written to accommodate, and each needs a chemistry decision rather than code: issue #273.
# Since #273 (2026-11-28) it is empty: araOct and manOct give their anomeric carbon as ?, gro-D-manHep and
# gro-D-glcHep no longer open with ?, and L-gro-D-glcOct, which disagreed with itself three ways, is gone.
